players.bio: Abdoul Karim Coulibaly (born 23 May 2007) is a German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen. He has played for the Germany under-17 national team. Club care
Becket Fabrice-Martial Godo (born 14 March 2003), known as Martial Godo, is an English professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Premier League club Fulham U21's.
Conrad Harder Weibel Schandorf is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Denmark national team.
Dário Cassia Luís Essugo is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg, on loan from Premier League club Chelsea.
Deivid Washington de Souza Eugênio, known as Deivid Washington or simply Deivid, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg.
Emmanuel Esseh Emegha (born 3 February 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Chelsea and the Netherlands national team.

Fábio Amado Uri Baldé (born 20 July 2005) is a German-French professional footballer who plays as a winger for Hamburger SV. Born in Germany, he currently plays for the Portugal U21s. Club career Baldé is a product of the youth academies of ESV Einigkeit, FC Süderelbe, and SC Vorwärts-Wacker 04, before joining Hamburger SVs youth academy in 2020.

Filip Jörgensen (born 16 April 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg, on loan from Premier League club Chelsea. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Denmark national team.

Genesis Kofi Koranteng Antwi (born 11 May 2007) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Chelsea. Born in Sweden, he previously represented England as a youth international before switching his allegiance to Sweden. Early life Antwi was born on 11 May 2007 in Stockholm, Sweden to Ghanaian parents.
Gessime Yassine (born 22 November 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Born in France, he represents the Morocco national team.

Giovanni Alejandro Reyna (born November 13, 2002) is an American professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Bundesliga club Borussia Mönchengladbach and the United States national team.
Hugo Filipe Carvalho Oliveira (born 22 June 1979) is a Portuguese football manager and goalkeeping coach who is the current manager of Ligue 1 club Strasbourg.
Ismaël Landry Doukouré (born 24 July 2003) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or a defensive midfielder for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg.
Jeyland Yahir Mitchell Baltodano is a Costa Rican professional footballer who plays as a defender for Austrian Bundesliga club Sturm Graz, on loan from Feyenoord, and the Costa Rica national team.
Joaquín Panichelli (born 7 October 2002) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg and the Argentina national team.

Karl-Johan Anton Johnsson (born 28 January 1990) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper. Starting off his career in Sweden with Halmstads BK, Johnsson has gone on to represent NEC, Randers, and Guingamp before signing with Copenhagen in 2019.

Lucas Høgsberg (born 23 June 2006) is a Danish footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg and the Denmark national team. In March 2025, 18-year-old Høgsberg was called up for the Danish national team for the first time for the 2024-25 UEFA Nations League A quarterfinals against Portugal.

Becket Fabrice-Martial Godo (born 14 March 2003), known as Martial Godo, is a professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Born in England, he is a youth international for the Ivory Coast. Club career Godo started his professional football career at Dartford when he joined them in 2019 and progressed through the club's youth system.

Mateo Del Blanco (born 31 October 2003) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left back for Unión de Santa Fe in the Argentine Primera División. Career He came through the academy at Union de Santa Fe after joining in 2014 from Corinthians Santa Fe.
Maximillian Rotimi Oyedele (born 7 November 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Born in England, he represents the Poland national team.

Omari Jamian Kellyman is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Kellyman was a product of the Derby County and Aston Villa academies, making his professional debut at the latter in August 2023. Having broken into the senior Aston Villa side in the 2023–24 season, he subsequently signed for Chelsea in June 2024.

Joaquín Martínez Gauna (born 9 July 2003), commonly known as Oso, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Sevilla Atlético. Mainly a left-back, he can also play as a left winger. Career Born in Torrevieja, Alicante, Valencian Community, Oso began his career with Algorfa CF, and subsequently represented Kelme CF and Real Murcia CF before joining Málaga CF's youth sides in 2018.
Samuel Christian Osaze Amo-Ameyaw (born 18 July 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg, on loan from Premier League club Southampton.

Samir El Mourabet (Arabic: سمير المرابط; born 6 October 2005) is a professional football player who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Born in France, he represents the Morocco national team. El Mourabet joined the youth academy of Strasbourg as a youth, before switching to futsal with Lyon Futsal, returning to Strasbourg in 2022.
Algot Sebastian Nanasi (born 16 May 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or forward for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg and the Sweden national team.
Sékou Mara is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Auxerre on loan from Strasbourg.

Stefan Bajic (born 23 December 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Strasbourg. Professional career On 2 May 2018, Bajic signed his first professional contract with his childhood club Saint-Étienne. He made his professional debut with Saint-Étienne in a 1–0 Ligue 1 loss to FC Metz on 25 September 2019.
